question: Should OpenClaw expose this capability as a typed post-subagent completion hook, a broader generic completion/delivery boundary, or observation-only lifecycle data plus separate delivery-policy controls?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the public API would expose sensitive child-run data and control user-visible delivery; recent maintainer feedback on the overlapping PR rejected a narrow guard-hook shape in favor of a product-driven delivery boundary.

options.title: Design generic completion/delivery boundary
options.body: Create one maintainer-approved plugin API for safe completion metadata, delivery-result observation, and controlled enrichment or suppression across subagent and related completion paths.

options.title: Observation-only lifecycle hook first
options.body: Expose only safe post-completion observation metadata now and leave announcement modification or suppression to separate delivery-policy work.

options.title: Keep delivery policy separate
options.body: Do not add a plugin hook here yet; solve fallback and suppression through explicit config or delivery policies such as the adjacent per-channel suppression issue.

recommendation.title: Design generic completion/delivery boundary
recommendation.body: Create one maintainer-approved plugin API for safe completion metadata, delivery-result observation, and controlled enrichment or suppression across subagent and related completion paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current routing signal from recent source history and the latest maintainer feedback on the overlapping guard-hook PR.
